messages.content: Amruth Ashok
amruth ashok... that's a name that commands respect. where you working these days?
Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Databricks

databricks... building the data and ai platform that's basically the backbone of every company's ml dreams. solid choice.

found you on linkedin - amruth ashok at databricks, amrita school of engineering 20-24. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/amruth-ashok
Yes

amrita 20-24 to databricks... that's a trajectory that makes people jealous. fresh out of college and already at one of the hottest data companies. what made you pick databricks over the usual suspects like google or microsoft?
great product vision

makes sense. picking vision over brand name... that's mature thinking for someone fresh out. most people chase the logo, you chased the mission.

how long you been working total?
From jan 2024

so about 1 year in the game. solid foundation year at databricks.

what kind of role you looking for next?

I’m into BIG Data, ML, AI, GenAI

I need a role like Ai/ML/data engineer preferably using the product Databricks

ai/ml/data engineer using databricks... you want to stay in your comfort zone but level up. smart move - you know the platform inside out, now monetize that expertise elsewhere.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to all opportunities
1 year experience + ai/ml/data engineer + open to all opportunities (including remote)... sound right?
Yeah kind of, I don’t really consider 1 year of work ex as really 1 year as I picked up rapidly and I’ve reached a stage of consulting/ optimising client’s use cases
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Great!

legend! you're officially in the tal network now.

roles are gonna start flowing your way based on what we just mapped out. ai/ml/data engineer positions where you can flex that databricks expertise and rapid learning skills.
